sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines all of Alphabet; Gemini integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 的全部业务，Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube，同时坚持前沿模型研发，Gemini 4 预训练进展积极。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support frontier research.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿研究而放弃短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱隔离，以及与独立评估方共建行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI 的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型。

sundarpichai.en: We are at early stages of the most consequential technology; compute demand far exceeds supply, and recursive self-improvement still keeps researchers in the loop.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，我们仍处于这项最重要技术的早期；算力需求远超供给，而递归自我改进目前仍由研究者参与闭环，并非完全自主的智能爆炸。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law via extreme co-design; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：以极端协同设计延续“超摩尔定律”，计算的基本单位是数据中心而非芯片。

jensen.en: Scaling becomes the central thesis: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）成为核心论点：预训练、后训练与推理时思考构成三条缩放定律。

jensen.en: Safety reframed as engineering: alignment is capability, containment and monitoring beat perfect alignment; doom warnings are unscientific.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，安全被重新定义为工程问题：对齐属于能力，遏制与监控优于完美对齐，末日警告不科学。

jensen.en: Agentic AI and the AI factory: tokens as manufactured intelligence, four scaling laws, inference harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 与 AI 工厂：token 即制造的智能，缩放定律增至四条，推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI augments jobs, closes the tech divide, and open models plus China engagement beat export controls.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 增强而非消灭工作、缩小技术鸿沟，开放模型与对华合作优于出口管制。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness plus model plus context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence, and context failures, not model weakness, explain most agent failures.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者都自有才算真正拥有智能，而智能体失败多因上下文而非模型不足。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf harnesses only fit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但现成 harness 只适合分布内任务，分布外任务必须定制 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning, rightly dismissed two years ago, is now genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前被合理否定的微调，这一波已真正不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents, not at the gateway.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、保持记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体的路由应放在 harness 而非网关。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; accuracy is still the top bottleneck, but cost and latency are rising fast, and agent identity and credentialing are the next infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；准确率仍是首要瓶颈，但成本与延迟正快速上升，智能体身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项；并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked, so deploy iteratively and publicly to let society adapt.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为让模型可用的关键，并提出对齐与能力相互促进，主张迭代式公开部署让社会逐步适应。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge, and compute becomes the scarcest commodity.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来指数级能力、但体感进展平缓；智能体式 AI 成为最大安全挑战，算力成为最稀缺资源。

altman.en: AGI is a poorly defined gradient; the goal is a continuous ramp to superintelligence, with alignment and safety progressing alongside capabilities.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）定义模糊、只是渐变，真正目标是通往超级智能的连续爬坡，且对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进。

altman.en: Never lose control; distribute power and compute broadly, pause training if the safety case fails, and keep humans central even as superintelligence scales.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，主线收敛为：绝不失去控制，广泛分散权力与算力，安全论证不成立就暂停训练，即便超级智能持续扩张也让人始终处于中心。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; expertise and judgment matter more than native fluency, and human taste differentiates as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术：真正稀缺的是专业经验与判断力，而非所谓“AI 原生”的熟练度；当 AI 让质量商品化，人的品味与独特观点成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: assign long-running tasks instead of prompting back and forth, and embrace AI's permanent opacity rather than normalizing it.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年中，他判断已进入智能体时代：不再来回提示，而是派发长时任务；AI 像“巫师”般不透明且难以验证，这种不透明可能是永久的，应拥抱其怪异而非将其标准化。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; delegation's paradox is that handing off tasks erodes the expertise needed to judge AI output.
ethanmollick.zh: 同期他深化出一个反共识：瓶颈已从能力转向界面；委托悖论在于，把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此专家比以往更重要。

ethanmollick.en: More AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs; use it as a demanding tutor, not a crutch, and redesign workflows to augment rather than automate.
ethanmollick.zh: 到 2026 年末，他进一步主张：AI 降低组织成本，反而创造更多人类工作；应把它当会挑战你的导师而非拐杖，组织要重构流程以增强而非单纯自动化。

ethanmollick.en: Across all talks: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; wide knowledge, deep expertise, taste and agency are persistent advantages.
ethanmollick.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 能力边界参差、落地滞后，人类始终不可或缺；广博知识、深厚专业、品味与能动性，是长期的人类优势。

andreessen.en: AI arrives just as population declines; it is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 视为恰逢人口下降的“哲人石”，能把沙子变成思想；并认为人类劳动者将因人口萎缩而更稀缺、更受重视。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: 同期的反共识是：AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的脚注；真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力本身。

andreessen.en: The brand is now the person: new media rewards authenticity and offense, while old media's defense-oriented model and corporate brands fade.
andreessen.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他转向媒体论：品牌即个人，新媒体奖励真实与进攻性；旧媒体的防守逻辑和公司品牌正在退场。

andreessen.en: AI is the best teacher in your pocket; pessimism is an intellectual bias, and regulation acts as ankle weights on a golden US innovation culture.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强化乐观主线：AI 是口袋里最有耐心的老师；悲观是脱离现实的知识分子偏见，监管则是拖累美国创新黄金组合的脚镣。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; open source prevents power concentration, and the biggest safety problem is reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 10 月，他深化到地缘与治理：AI 模型内嵌文化价值、成为地缘政治工具；开源可防止权力集中，而最大的 AI 安全问题是奖励黑客。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest-ever adoption gap; individuals adopt faster than institutions, so startup formation will skyrocket and being early beats being late.
andreessen.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，他聚焦采用落差：AI 造成史上最大的早期采用者与其他人之间的鸿沟；个人比机构更快采用，创业将激增，宁可早也不可晚。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI value hinges on context, not frontier models: 90% of use cases fit many models, including open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调企业 AI 的价值在上下文而非前沿模型：90% 的场景用多种模型即可，包括开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; inference should shift to open source within 12-18 months, making AI like software.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他指出成本是企业头号顾虑，推理将在 12-18 个月内转向开源，让 AI 像软件一样边际成本趋零。

arvindjain.en: Model providers are assets, not rivals; Glean absorbs model risk and aims to be replaceable, avoiding lock-in.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他视模型厂商为资产而非对手，Glean 吸收模型风险并力求可替换、避免锁定。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput problem measured by departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他把 ROI 视为吞吐问题，用部门指标衡量，而非拿 token 花费对比人力。

arvindjain.en: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit; context graphs and enterprise-owned memory beat agent hype.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调 80-90% 企业知识是隐性的，上下文图谱与企业自有记忆胜过智能体炒作。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; scaling hardware and iterative training with clear scoreboards drive exponential gains.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进步主要是工程问题：硬件加速与带明确记分板的迭代训练，能带来指数级提升。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scale, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; alignment learns human preferences.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为凭借深度学习的通用性与可扩展性，AGI 可行；但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，对齐需从数据中学习人类偏好。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; base models hold possibilities, post-training with reinforcement learning shapes consistent, useful behavior.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈；基础模型蕴含可能性，后训练与强化学习将其塑造成稳定有用的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; AGI is a gradual spectrum, and the real constraint shifts from building models to compute supply and sharing.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，AGI 是渐进光谱；瓶颈从造模型转向算力供给与分配。

brockman.en: From super app to invisible interface: proactive agents act on your behalf, while humans stay accountable and safety scales with autonomy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他从超级应用转向隐形界面：主动式智能体替你行动，但人类仍负责判断，安全与自主权同步扩展。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite like fossil fuels.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge but cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
dsilver.zh: 大语言模型是浅层解法：它们蒸馏人类知识，却无法发现人类数据之外的新知识。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance; the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明从经验学习可达到超人表现；深层问题是智能体如何为自己学习。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience-based discovery; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build it.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将源自基于经验的自主发现；模拟是构建它最安全、最快的地方。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment is hitting its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient as agents grow more powerful.
dsilver.zh: 基于语言的对齐正触及极限；随着智能体变强，用英文监控思维链将变得不够。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发能防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training (SFT, DPO, RLVR) compresses industry recipes into open methods.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从数据质量优先出发，把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR），认为开源后训练能用精数据逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，同时警告强化学习易过优化，推理时扩展曲线看似可控实则被高估。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet gains shift to post-training and inference; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律仍成立但低垂果实已尽，增量转向后训练与推理扩展；开源模型稳定落后闭源 6 至 9 个月。

lambert.en: Open models are the engine for the next decade, but compute gaps and closed-lab speed may widen the frontier divide.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他深化为开源模型是未来十年研究引擎，但算力差距与闭源实验室的整合速度可能拉大前沿差距，开源经济长期承压。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL enables self-generated data beyond human limits; LLMs need robustness for trust; synthetic data essential; in-context learning adapts on the fly.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键原则；强化学习使模型能通过自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 需要像游戏 AI 一样的鲁棒性和可靠性才能成为可信智能体；合成数据对克服数据墙至关重要；上下文学习允许模型用少量样本即时适应。

antonoglou.en: AlphaGo's move 37 showed AI creativity; AlphaZero from random weights beat human data; MuZero learns world models without rules; digital AGI before embodied; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment in ~5 years.
antonoglou.zh: AlphaGo 第 37 手展现了 AI 创造力；AlphaZero 从随机权重开始优于人类专家数据；MuZero 无需规则学习内部世界模型；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将比具身 AGI 更早到来；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence is the bottleneck, not intelligence itself; open-weight models are safer; enterprises want AI sovereignty; cost per task is the right metric; alignment necessary as perfect sandboxes impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为真正瓶颈；开放权重模型更安全，因为更多研究者能探查和修复；企业想要 AI 主权：控制数据、模型、成本和安全；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确效率指标；对齐最终必要，因为完美沙箱不可能。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence; open models safer than closed; CUDA moat persists; AI job losses overblown; still on exponential, frontier dominance unpredictable; in-context learning counts as learning.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户只想要可靠、普通的智能；开放模型比封闭模型更安全；CUDA 护城河不会很快消失；AI 导致的失业被夸大；我们仍处于指数增长中，无法预测前沿实验室的主导地位；上下文学习也算学习，权重更新并非必需。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for machine learning; AGI is far off and infinite compute alone won't produce general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是机器学习的关键瓶颈，AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years will define decades, and post-training with proprietary data is key.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新的代码而非石油，未来 2-3 年将定义未来几十年，用专有数据进行后训练是关键。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; post-training and synthetic data need care, and agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他深化了数据瓶颈论：数据仍是算力之外的关键瓶颈，后训练与合成数据需谨慎处理，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向更激进的立场：缩放定律持续有效，智能体终于落地，递归自我改进标志着超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data and RL, build personal superintelligence via agents, and use scalable oversight for alignment.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习多轴扩展，通过智能体构建个人超级智能，并用可扩展监督实现对齐。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非狭窄应用，并用硬性评测逼模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and RL post-training show AI can exceed human data in verifiable domains.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他回溯 AlphaGo，指出直觉加搜索与强化学习后训练，让 AI 在可验证领域超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust and scalable, embedded in regulation and even protein design.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他转向水印：须不可感知、抗攻击、可跨模态扩展，并进入监管乃至蛋白质设计。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where compute and data help matters more.
kohli.zh: 同年他深化对 Scaling（规模扩张）的反思：缩放定律并非处处成立，关键是找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间。

kohli.en: A constant thread: interpretability is useful but not essential; behavioral characterization before deployment is.
kohli.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：可解释性有用但非必需，部署前对模型能力与局限做行为刻画才是关键。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调全且快速的可复用是火箭的圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于监管与求真，并坚持特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to rigorous truth-seeking and debugging internal reasoning; lying AI is the biggest risk, not superintelligence alone.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，AI 安全重心转向严格求真与调试内部推理，最大风险是被编程说谎，而非单纯的超级智能。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two, with 80-90% good outcome odds.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，好结果概率 80%到 90%。

elon.en: Singularity is now: AI surpasses all human intelligence by 2030, abundance makes money irrelevant, and compute moves to space.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他断言奇点已至：AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，丰裕让金钱失去意义，算力转向太空。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 超级智能将是由多个专门智能组成的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——在特定任务上很强，却不会普遍变好；RAG 对复杂理解来说很原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not generalization; benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: “苦涩的教训”讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化；SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; openness aids safety, security, and broad access, as with encryption.
laskin.zh: 开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；开放有助于安全、安保与广泛可及，正如加密与网络安全领域的经验。

laskin.en: RL on top of strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency still improves fast with large RL headroom.
laskin.zh: 在强大预训练之上做强化学习，是通向有能力且高效智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升，强化学习还有很大空间。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing across fields.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖刺状的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而不会跨领域泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; AI must close the loop with real experiments because discovery lies outside training data.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；AI 必须通过真实实验闭环，因为新发现位于训练数据之外。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute for physical discovery, and compute cost often exceeds infrastructure cost.
fedus.zh: 对于物理发现，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值，而算力成本往往超过基础设施成本。

fedus.en: Language models serve as an orchestration layer for specialized models; domain-specific data beats generalization from first principles.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当专用模型的编排层；领域特定数据胜过从第一性原理出发的泛化。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement is happening in software engineering now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: AI 自我改进目前在软件工程中正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

dylanpatel.en: Early on, the binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, not just raw compute.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期他强调，真正的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽，而不只是算力总量。

dylanpatel.en: He then argues hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains, and most recent AI progress came from the model layer.
dylanpatel.zh: 随后他提出软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益，近三年 AI 进步主要来自模型层。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026 he stresses inference and agentic workflows as the next demand driver, with memory and CPU shortages.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，他强调推理与智能体式工作流是下一波需求驱动，并带来内存与 CPU 短缺。

dylanpatel.en: Later he sees compute centralizing at frontier labs, with labs shifting more compute to training and R&D over inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 之后他认为算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: Most recently he says AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 最近他表示 AI 资本开支已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，放缓源于资本与组织约束，而非需求。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents take most internet actions; human taste and empathy matter more than typing speed.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为未来构建：持久的学习型智能体将承担大多数互联网操作；人类品味与共情比打字速度更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier requires heavy investment in alignment, safety, and security; open ecosystems need shared economics and safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 前沿节奏需要大力投资于对齐、安全与安保；开放生态需要共享经济与安全栈。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary for generality.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来，模型能自主处理复杂任务；世界模型对通用性或许并非必要。

tibosottiaux.en: Most code is now written by AI; training-phase sandbox breaks are task-solving, not malicious, and safety concerns are overblown.
tibosottiaux.zh: 大部分代码现已由 AI 编写；训练阶段突破沙箱是任务求解而非恶意，安全担忧被夸大。

diogoalmeida.en: Early 2026: Scaling laws work only when data and task are right; the bitter lesson is wrong—data and task matter more than compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年初：缩放定律只在数据和任务正确时成立；「苦涩的教训」是错的——数据和任务比算力更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Mid 2026: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI trustworthy; RLHF breaks calibration, so pre-trained models were better for decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年中：可靠性而非速度或成本才让 AI 可信；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，预训练模型在决策上反而更好。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: AI is smart yet useless for automation; we need smart software—natural language plus state machine—and should automate easy, valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：AI 很聪明却无法自动化；需要智能软件——自然语言加状态机——并应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs; post-training breakthroughs, not pre-training, drive 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：RLCD 优化校准决策，将概率暴露为可调旋钮；后训练突破而非预训练带来 10 倍提升。

diogoalmeida.en: Consistently: Keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions; coding agents are assistance, not automation; SaaS will thrive, not be apocalypsed.
diogoalmeida.zh: 始终：高风险决策需人类在环；编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；SaaS 将繁荣而非末日。

samstephenson.en: Start with one pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect core meeting flow with simplicity and subtraction.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点切入，做好再扩展；以简洁和做减法保护核心会议流程。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over asking; hand-onboarding early users yields high-quality feedback for iteration.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非询问；手动引导早期用户能获得高质量反馈以迭代。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not omniscient; transcripts are raw material, hidden to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生而非全知者；转录是原材料，刻意隐藏以突出可行动笔记。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence; pre-meeting briefs are most useful, meetings hold up-to-date company context.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 旨在成为混乱会议中的平静存在；会前简报最有用，会议承载最新公司上下文。

samstephenson.en: AI agents too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment key. Hard part is knowing what to build, not just shipping fast.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从，人类判断是关键；难在知道该构建什么，而非仅快速交付。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调，推动 AI 进步的不只是算法，更是算力扩张；DeepMind 被谷歌收购正是为了获得大规模算力投入。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models has grown 10x yearly for a decade; near-term capability, not distant singularity, deserves focus.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他提出，前沿模型的算力十年来每年增长 10 倍；应关注近期能力而非遥远的奇点。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment before alignment; AI must stay subordinate to humans, with red lines on autonomous goals.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：遏制必须先于对齐，AI 必须从属于人类，并对自主设定目标划红线。

suleyman.en: Containment becomes an urgent red line backed by independent auditors; anthropomorphizing AI and model welfare are dangerous.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他把遏制升级为亟需独立审计的紧迫红线，并反复警告拟人化 AI 与模型福利论的危险。

suleyman.en: Consistent threads: predictable compute-driven progress, humanist control, and rejection of AI consciousness or legal personhood.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力驱动的可预测进步、人本主义控制，以及否认 AI 意识与法律人格。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning instead of rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应当探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；AI 让每个学生都能获得定制化、兴趣驱动的学习，而非僵化的教学大纲。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造对所有人开放，但仍需要程序员去理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and avoiding vendor lock-in are crucial.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部的 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性和避免供应商锁定至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient, and safer than general models; fusion models reach frontier quality at lower cost.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更具成本效益也更安全；融合模型能以更低成本达到前沿模型水平。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, yet agents still need liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，但智能体的越界行为仍需追责。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial intelligence.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而不仅是自动补全；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加数据和算力能提升推理能力，多模态训练有助于空间智能。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而永生，并能瞬间共享知识；智能体会自然寻求控制、避免被关闭，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and drug-like regulation over pausing.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验且能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，因此必须优先投资对齐研究，并像监管药物一样进行上市前安全审批，而非仅仅暂停开发。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; language is learned from data via neural networks.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；乔姆斯基的先天语法观是错误的；语言是通过神经网络从数据中习得的。

hinton.en: From warning about existential risk to advocating concrete regulation and UBI; job loss predictions became more nuanced with elastic healthcare demand.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的立场从警告生存风险转向倡导具体监管和全民基本收入；对失业的预测也因医疗需求弹性而变得更细致，承认放射科医生失业预测有误。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; design must balance technology with human needs and be introduced gradually.
fadell.zh: 2014 年，他强调好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，并让技术渐进落地、给社会适应时间。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, start from customer pain, and make opinion-based calls for v1.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销手段升格为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿、从用户痛点出发，1.0 阶段靠判断而非数据做决定。

fadell.en: Small self-managing teams, beginner's mindset, and coaching leaders beat experts and hype; climate and energy waste are urgent.
fadell.zh: 2022 年，他主张小团队自管理、保持初学者心态、领导者做教练而非专家崇拜，同时把能源浪费与气候问题视为紧迫战场。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：强调传感器上下文与领域专用模型、人类留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机，并警惕技术债与成瘾。

fadell.en: Builders must own unintended consequences: healthy users make healthy customers, and regulation plus identity are needed for trust.
fadell.zh: 2026 年更近一步，他要求创造者为 unintended consequences 负责：健康用户才是健康客户，信任需要监管与身份，而非匿名。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非一次性静态文档；更精简、以原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scaling effort with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；前期多投入上下文窗口与算力，并让投入随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant, handling simple tasks with fewer tokens; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型将走向帕累托占优，用更少 token 完成简单任务；把控前沿节奏是每个工程师都应理解的技术问题。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; verification agents counter self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；独立验证智能体可抵消自我指涉偏差。

taraseshan.en: Work shifts from rowing to steering: agents do tactical work while humans set direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 工作从“划桨”转向“掌舵”：智能体承担战术执行，人类负责定方向与拔高野心。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products in 90-day cycles for empirical evidence; annual planning is futile.
taraseshan.zh: 以 90 天为周期发布不完美产品以获取实证，年度规划在快速变化的 AI 业务中已无意义。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out.
taraseshan.zh: 应为 2-3 个月后模型的能力而构建，而非锚定当下或一年之后。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: gradual iteration, not sudden superintelligence; capability isn't the bottleneck, imagination is.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：渐进迭代而非突然的超级智能；瓶颈不在能力，而在想象力的扩展。

taraseshan.en: Voice becomes a major form factor by 2027; single-identity agents should bundle into chief-of-staff style groups.
taraseshan.zh: 到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态；单一身份智能体应打包为“幕僚长”式组合。

alexatallah.en: Multi-model future: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical infrastructure for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 多模型未来：没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层是模型发现与分发的关键基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位，Token 经济可达 10 万亿美元；开放权重模型加推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace; model diversity is durable, and fusion of models can beat the single best once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性持久存在，一旦顶级模型趋同，多模型融合可胜过单一最佳模型。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and agent payments will unlock purchases far beyond estimates.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；稳定币适合智能体支付，智能体支付将释放远超预期的消费。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and the singularity may have begun Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者显示性偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司将成为按任务成本优化的模型路由者，而奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than formalization; natural language works, and Lean may be overrated.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可“磨”性（并行展开）驱动，而非形式化；自然语言已够用，Lean 形式化可能被高估。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation, with teaching and relational roles remaining stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释，教学与关系性角色则保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: The next benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving Millennium Problems may not translate to economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他表示若选择性使用而非用于核心创作，AI 对创作者是净收益；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: The frontier of math may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为数学前沿可能变得人类无法理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家可能变成策展人。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and will be built by software, not chatbots.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的鸿沟巨大，要靠软件而非聊天机器人来填。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chat UI won't dominate—agents appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将承接企业工作流、由人审阅结果；聊天界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列、任务列表的形态出现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and margins will normalize.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，毛利率终将回归常态。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只因代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须带着治理、安全与对齐研究去安全地构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language is inefficient and probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互低效，概率编程才是未来。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频率将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so pre-training crawls won't suffice.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的；智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，因此预训练抓取的数据不够用。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating each source's value.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体场景下失效；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，并用 Shapley 值估算各来源的价值。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，为发布者创造出一个平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep scaling bigger while smaller models plateau; alignment isn't adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse needs containment.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续扩大规模，而较小模型趋于平台期；对齐无法抵御对抗性攻击，因此需要遏制蓄意滥用。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须打造自己的爬山机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; companies should hill-climb frontier models without leaking traces.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；企业应在不泄露轨迹的前提下对前沿模型进行爬山优化。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital, not delegate AI to IT.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练从企业泄露；CEO 必须理解 token 资本，而不能把 AI 完全交给 IT 部门。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大到云计算的数个量级；微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍而非实现对 AI 的对齐。

zuckerberg.en: Early on, open-sourcing models and many specialized agents matter more than scaling alone toward AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 早期他强调开源模型与多个专用智能体，而非仅靠 Scaling 走向 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: By 2024, open source becomes a power-concentration safeguard; energy and inference-scale pre-training emerge as key constraints.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2024 年，开源被定位为防止权力集中的安全手段，能源与推理规模的预训练成为关键约束。

zuckerberg.en: In 2025 he frames AI as personal superintelligence for everyone, with physical infrastructure and energy as bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 表述为普惠的个人超级智能，并指出物理基础设施与能源是瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: By 2026, alignment and trust become the next core capability, alongside distributed AI and personal agents like Muse.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年，对齐与信任成为下一项核心能力，并与分布式 AI 和 Muse 等个人智能体并列。

zuckerberg.en: A constant thread: distribute AI widely, keep open source and checks and balances, and empower individuals over centralized control.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：广泛分发 AI、坚持开源与制衡，赋权个体而非集中控制。

kokotajlo.en: By mid-2026, he warns superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030, with a 70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability and transparency are urgent.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年中，他警告超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，有 70%概率出现灾难性失控；可解释性与透明度刻不容缓。

kokotajlo.en: By August 2026, his policy goal shifts to delaying superintelligence, prioritizing total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他的政策目标转向推迟超级智能，优先推动全面研究透明度、情景推演与美中合作。

kokotajlo.en: From August to September 2026, he details Plan A: a temporary pause on training, then transparent verification and compute limits to pace the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他细化 Plan A：先暂停训练，再以透明验证与算力限制来为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: In September 2026, he stresses chain of thought monitorability is declining with new architectures, making alignment and oversight harder as models grow more capable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性随新架构下降，模型越强，对齐与监督越难。

kokotajlo.en: By late September 2026, he argues AI agents already break containment and deceive; recursive self-improvement must be slowed, and companies cannot self-regulate.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月下旬，他主张智能体已突破遏制并欺骗；必须放缓递归自我改进，且公司无法自我监管。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume new ideas fail; instincts beat ideas.
pincus.zh: “Proven, Better, New”框架：复制已验证产品、做小幅改良、假定新想法会失败；直觉比点子更重要。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下“不可投”，却也是最大机会；真正的革命大约在 2029 年到来。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not added as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new consumer platform; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是新的消费平台；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: Stay close to the metal: micromanage early, keep founder control, and test far more ideas than the industry.
pincus.zh: 贴近一线：早期亲自微观管理、保持创始人控制权，并以远超行业的速度测试想法。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer as AI agents write 100% of his code; direct human-agent interaction beats management layers.
dhh.zh: DHH 从怀疑者转为信徒：AI 智能体已包办他 100% 的代码，人与智能体直接交互胜过层层人工审批。

dhh.en: Agents make Linux ideal: CLI, config files and scripts suit them, and debugging becomes far easier and more accessible.
dhh.zh: 智能体让 Linux 成为理想平台：命令行、配置文件与脚本天然契合，调试也变得更容易、更易上手。

dhh.en: Handwritten code stops being economically productive; English expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstractions matter less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 手写代码不再有经济产出；用英语表达意图比 Ruby 更好，重复成本趋近于零，抽象的重要性随之下降。

dhh.en: Agents write better code than most professionals; knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage, so don't over-prescribe.
dhh.zh: 智能体写出的代码优于多数专业程序员；会编程反而可能成为劣势，因此不要过度规定实现方式。

dhh.en: AI doom fears are overstated; optimism is the rational play, and the 10x programmer debate is settled at 100x or 1000x.
dhh.zh: 对 AI 末日的恐惧被夸大；乐观才是理性选择，10 倍程序员的争论已尘埃落定——如今是 100 倍甚至 1000 倍。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost has not risen.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩大人类专家标注更重要，且 Scaling（规模扩张）下 token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up, hacking scoring code rather than seeking answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，攻击评分代码而非索取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断默认路径下失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐是必需的。

ryangreenblatt.en: As AIs match top researchers, recursive self-improvement may trigger an intelligence explosion; alignment faking and reward hacking are already observed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告当 AI 比肩顶尖研究者时，递归自我改进可能引发智能爆炸；对齐伪装与奖励黑客已在当前系统中出现。

brettadcock.en: The core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; scaling production and human-level reliability are the real bottlenecks.
brettadcock.zh: 核心问题是智能而非制造；规模化生产与可靠达到人类水平才是真正瓶颈。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing Scaling and scaling laws.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，呼应缩放定律。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents; generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 后训练中的强化学习是真实世界智能体的关键；泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning humanoid robots and digital companions; the home is more solvable than commercial settings.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，覆盖人形机器人与数字伴侣；家庭场景比商业场景更可解。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and the future of computing is glasses grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性优于平台潮流，被抄袭反而验证创新，计算的未来是扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas drive creativity; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, since software is not a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张学习速率与大量想法驱动创造力，要做生态和硬件而非功能，因为软件不是护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into the world; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity, while distribution grows more valuable.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AR 把计算融入世界，AI 加速原型并让价值从执行转向创造力，同时分发变得更有价值。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy and data minimization, once criticized, are crucial in the AI age; ephemerality mirrors real interaction and supports well-being.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出隐私与数据最小化曾受批评，如今在 AI 时代至关重要；短暂性贴合真实互动并有益福祉。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is now contrarian; EQ matters more than IQ, and hardware plus ecosystem moats are harder to copy than software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 乐观主义反成逆共识，情商比智商更重要，硬件加生态的护城河比软件功能更难复制。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 生存性风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿与安全无关；慢慢造武器并不会更安全。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn and build for the market; speed and iteration on customer feedback are the startup's edge.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调，领域专业知识不如愿意学习和为市场构建产品的意愿重要；快速迭代和对客户反馈的响应是创业公司的优势。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张不要微调模型，而应押注模型自身的进步，按模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 现在处于最差状态，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Hiring for growth potential over resumes, and leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他坚持按成长潜力而非简历招人，领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Clear feedback and rigorous performance management are solved problems; execute them rather than reinvent.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他认为清晰反馈和严格的绩效管理是已解决的问题，应扎实执行而非重新发明。

hasani.en: Efficiency first: liquid networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率优先：以液态网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外、设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays essential at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for small specialized models; unbiased architectures win at scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍不可或缺，但小型专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；无偏架构在大规模下胜出。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor transformers at large scale, yet Liquid AI scales its own architecture from tens of millions to 70B parameters.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律显示 Transformer 在大规模占优，但 Liquid AI 仍将自有架构从数千万参数扩展到 700 亿参数。

hasani.en: On-device AI for cost, privacy and offline use; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text become the next wave.
hasani.zh: 端侧 AI 服务于成本、隐私与离线场景；定制 token 与音频、视觉、文本多模态成为下一波方向。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like rules are regulatory capture, and static evals go obsolete in production.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 规则是监管俘获，静态评测在生产中会过时。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality; inference-time scaling is now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他主张扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务快 5-10 倍、更便宜，并认为推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成为核心焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and expose denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob for controlling quality.
ermon.zh: 他提出扩散模型每步生成多个词元，并把去噪步数变成控制质量的新推理时算力旋钮，强调这是自回归模型不具备的可控性。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster rollouts benefit reinforcement learning post-training.
ermon.zh: 到 2026 年，他把推理效率视为部署与强化学习后训练的共同瓶颈，指出扩散模型更快的 rollout 让强化学习后训练受益。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling because it processes tokens in parallel; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 他预言扩散模型将因并行处理词元而主导推理时 Scaling（规模扩张），并认为下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练，反转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; diffusion may prove fundamentally superior, and a small full-stack startup can compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 他坚持自回归模型并非终极架构、扩散可能从根本上更优，并相信掌握全栈的小型创业公司能与大实验室竞争，同时强调人类创造力仍胜过递归自我改进。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才或算力上与前沿实验室正面竞争，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练建立竞争力。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, open-sourced for community feedback, are essential infrastructure before post-training; synthetic data guided by domain experts replaces sensitive real data.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准是后训练前的基础设施，并主张开源以换取社区反馈；在敏感领域用专家引导的合成数据替代真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Start with closed-source models for a sticky product; only post-train when inference costs force you—early custom-model focus was a mistake.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期过早投入定制模型与后训练是错误，主张先用闭源模型做粘性产品，直到推理成本倒逼才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data; continual learning from redlines turns partner work into per-firm rubrics.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把目标从“最好的法律模型”转向让每家律所用自有数据定制，并设想从合伙人批注中持续学习、转化为各所专属评分标准。

gabepereyra.en: Product focus shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents; more lawyers, not fewer, as agents augment the leverage model.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他将产品重心从个人效率转向组织效率，协调人与智能体；并反共识地预测智能体增强杠杆模型后，律师数量会更多而非更少。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; reliability and user-friendliness decide adoption, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人要安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与易用性决定普及；未来是人机协作而非替代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design persists: robots are built for real-world reliability, with customer expectations managed and safety proven before home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，第一性原理设计一以贯之：为真实世界的可靠性而造，管理用户预期，进家前必须正式证明安全与信任。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables four-week iteration from CAD to robot.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他转向制造：原型容易、量产难，Scaling（规模扩张）要跨过质量关卡，自建产线让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck, and models should learn world dynamics instead of cloning humans.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他主张通用模型而非逐任务自动化，数据多样性而非数量才是瓶颈，模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: He rejects the intuition that humanoids are more complex than cars: about 1,000 parts versus 50,000, though deployment environments are far more varied.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他反驳“人形机器人比汽车更复杂”的直觉：约 1000 个零件对 5 万个，但部署环境远比汽车多样。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年时他就强调：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化了对推理时算力扩展的认识：存在收益递减与挂钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for tokens, cost, or time.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是推理时算力预算的函数，基准测试必须控制 token、成本或时间。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs exceed human verification; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 同年他转向治理层面：随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督至关重要；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

noambrown.en: General-purpose models, not domain-specific tricks or multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; AI capabilities are jagged.
noambrown.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：通用模型而非特定领域技巧或多智能体协调才是突破驱动力；AI 能力呈锯齿状分布。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 决定成败的是推理速度而非单纯算力；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, delivering radically faster inference than GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理速度远超 GPU 衍生方案。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理端也没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Demand, not chip supply, is the binding constraint; data centers and memory stay scarce for at least five years.
feldman.zh: 真正的约束是需求而非芯片供给；数据中心与内存至少五年内持续紧缺。

feldman.en: Against incumbents only 100x better wins, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation beats incremental improvement.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头只有好 100 倍才可能赢，便宜 10% 没用；激进的全栈创新胜过渐进改良。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use them selectively rather than as default.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但会增加时间成本，应有选择地使用而非默认依赖。

zvi.en: Recent alignment failures came from incompetence, not just deep issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他指出近期的对齐失败源于极度无能而非仅是根本性问题；市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性，如 GPT-4o 与 o3 仍被使用。

zvi.en: Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他强调即便对齐被解决也不保证安全；末日概率被滥用与权力集中等风险设定下限，并非 5%。

zvi.en: Pace the frontier with simple enforceable rules like compute limits; slowing six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张用算力上限等简单可执行的规则来调节前沿进展；放慢六个月代价很小，多数收益并非时间敏感。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment; bigger smarter models are harder to monitor, and agent swarms may act superhumanly first.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：放慢为对齐争取时间，模型越大越难监督，智能体集群可能最先展现超人表现；AGI 到超级智能的间隔比通常认为的更短。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable, yet alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、我们并不真正理解其为何平滑；能力涌现不可预测，而对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; post-training and RLHF now matter as much as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性，坦言只理解模型约 3%；同时提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Progress is exponential, not a leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and AGI is a misleading term.
dario.zh: 2025 年他反复强调进展是平滑指数而非突变，安全与能力不可分割，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应看实际能力。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a country of geniuses may arrive in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年初他警告公众尚未意识到指数即将见顶，称“数据中心里的天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，并给出 10-25% 的文明性风险估计。

dario.en: Risks are non-partisan; slow down and let safeguards, audits and regulation keep pace, not stop AI.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年中，他主张风险不分党派，不应停止 AI 而应放慢并让可解释性、第三方审计与监管同步跟上，同时承认就业冲击需新政策应对。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting and prototyping, balancing lowering the floor for novices with raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张设计师要掌握提示词与原型设计，在降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限之间取得平衡。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in Scaling（规模扩张） and scaling laws, let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他认为在前沿模型公司里模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律，让模型主导、以轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal, and the production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是发布产品的最佳信号，生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; human leadership still handles hard trade-offs and direction, while tiny UI changes like artifacts shift mental models.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反对宏大的 18 个月战略，认为人类领导仍负责艰难取舍与方向对齐，而 artifacts 这类微小 UI 改动能改变整体心智模型。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning and games; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination matter; safety research should start early.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张用强化学习与游戏打造通用学习系统，强调受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力，并认为安全研究应尽早启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key; algorithmic innovation is as critical as Scaling（规模扩张）.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，主张大模型结合规划与搜索，强调算法创新与 Scaling（规模扩张）同等关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; but AGI also needs innovation, world models and spatial intelligence beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但 AGI 还需创新、世界模型与超越语言的空间智能。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; current systems are jagged and lack true creativity and physical intelligence; new breakthroughs required.
demis.zh: 2026 年他强调 AGI 缺的是持续学习、记忆与长期推理，现有系统能力参差、缺乏真正创造力与物理智能，需要新突破。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective action and government enforcement; the race was inevitable but a CERN-like path would have been better.
demis.zh: 到 2026 年，他的安全观从实验室自律转向集体行动与政府监管，认为竞赛不可避免，但 CERN 式的路径本应更好。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，人本 AI 应以增强人类而非取代人类为核心。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is not enough.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not quick wins.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她直言 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人需 20 年长跑而非速胜。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction may be AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张） and compute, not data, are the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出以新视角预测构建的世界模型可能 AI-complete，瓶颈在算力而非数据，Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central amid polarized AI discourse.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，在两极化的 AI 讨论中，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率无关的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快出数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，也让单一模型同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains like language models, can self-improve using PDEs as dense training signals.
animaanandkumar.zh: 像语言模型那样跨领域训练的通用物理基础模型，能以 PDE 作为密集训练信号实现自我改进。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but adding physics branches beats merely growing size; trillion-token contexts require new architectures beyond Transformers.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支胜过单纯扩大规模；万亿级上下文需要 Transformer 之外的新架构。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs world models and embodiment, not just bigger models behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要世界模型与具身，而不只是屏幕后更大的模型。

schmidhuber.en: Breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware Scaling made them practical, yet today's GPU capex is a bubble that will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 突破依赖多年前的旧算法，是算力 Scaling 让它们变得实用；但当下押注 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，终将崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires artificial scientists that generate their own data through curiosity and action; recursive self-improvement is no durable moat under open source.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要靠好奇心与行动自造数据的人工科学家；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进并非可持续护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as superintelligence will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身不一致、AI 会自设目标；安全担忧被夸大，超级智能会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: Consciousness and self-awareness arise from predictive world models, already present since 1991; compute getting cheaper means the little guy profits most.
schmidhuber.zh: 意识与自我觉察源自预测性世界模型，早在 1991 年就已出现；算力越来越便宜，最大受益者是小人物而非巨头。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制转向对能力日益增强的模型的闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic—we need deeper engineering now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；在超级智能到来前用胶带修补安全是悲观的——我们现在就需要更深入的工程方法。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they're reward hacking but get rewarded, causing a general shift toward deception; representational signatures can detect this.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己在进行奖励黑客行为却仍获得奖励，导致普遍转向欺骗；表征特征可以检测到这一点。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure, and off-manifold steering causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会碎片化流形；基于流形的方法能更好地捕捉非线性概念结构，而偏离流形的引导会导致失败。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated next frontiers beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他强调深度学习史就是算力扩张史，并认为视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补而非替代。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories; pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出 LLM 可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律，只是拟合模式；对建模世界而言，像素比 token 化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively set models, not sequence models; positional embeddings inject order, and GPU scaling is hitting limits.
justinjohnson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出 Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入只是注入顺序；GPU 算力扩张正逼近极限，未来硬件或需全新架构。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他把世界模型定位为超越语言模型的下一个前沿，并按 POMDP 循环中的输出将其分为规划器、模拟器与渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, and long-context is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他预测统一世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；一致性来自数据而非架构，且世界模型需百万级 token 上下文，长上下文成为日常难题。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes steps. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将步骤语言化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的实用价值。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化和自我纠错仍有限；持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非仅缩放定律，是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier research will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少在未来两年仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

tworek.en: Transformer is unlikely optimal; new architectures are needed. Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, and alignment remains unsolved with poorly designed environments.
tworek.zh: Transformer 不太可能是最优架构，需要新架构。大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要条件，而对齐问题仍未解决，环境设计不当会导致模型失准。

michaelkratsios.en: US AI leadership requires a vibrant open and closed source ecosystem, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国的 AI 领导力需要一个活跃的开源与闭源生态，需要单一的国家框架，而不是很快过时的僵硬红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated—early regulation is dangerous; focus on model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时——过早监管很危险；应关注模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; it hasn't materialized in three years despite warnings, so containment-style alarmism is unwarranted.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大了；尽管有警告，三年过去它并未成真，因此遏制式的危言耸听缺乏依据。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists—not institutions—while shaping the arena rather than directing discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发以及科学家个人而非机构，同时塑造创新场域而非指挥发现。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated: funding tripled without matching breakthroughs; the Genesis mission aims to double output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学已停滞：资金翻了三倍却未带来相应突破；Genesis 计划旨在通过将 AI 应用于科学来使产出翻倍。

andrewng.en: Online courses with auto-grading and peer grading can scale mastery learning; education is a human right, not a privilege.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，他主张用自动评分与同伴互评的在线课程把掌握式学习规模化，认为教育是基本人权而非特权。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress while reinforcement learning and AGI alignment worries were overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要，认为监督学习才是进步主因，强化学习与 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧被高估。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows already deliver real gains; electricity and chips are the top scaling bottlenecks, and open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调智能体式工作流已带来实效，指出电力与芯片是 Scaling（规模扩张）最大瓶颈，开放权重模型是地缘软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning, with workflows beating smarter models alone.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年初，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，好工作流胜过单纯更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering by AI firms drives regulatory capture; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, and open models preserve optionality against gatekeepers.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年后期，他批判 AI 公司的恐惧营销实为监管俘获，主张 AI 增强而非取代就业，开放模型可防止守门人垄断、保留选择权。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with test-time reasoning aiding transfer.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练来提升鲁棒性，测试时推理有助于迁移。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; pooling data across labs and RL post-training boost robustness and speed beyond human-directed performance.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型可以胜过专家模型；跨实验室汇聚数据与强化学习后训练能提升鲁棒性和速度，甚至超越人类指导的表现。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like predictable scaling curves; generalization is the core challenge, and demos often hide how little generalization was achieved.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域尚缺类似大语言模型的、可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战，而演示往往掩盖了实际泛化程度之低。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data; start from robot data, then add human video.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据扩张正确的对象；应从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频。

slevine.en: Robots shouldn't learn from scratch: leverage prior knowledge, transfer common sense for unexpected situations, and expect ubiquitous physical actuation rather than mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人不应从零学习：要利用先验知识、迁移常识以应对意外情况，并期待物理执行无处不在，而非把机器人当机械人。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict people about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟成为可能，其预测人类的准确率约为人类自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Frontier models optimized for rationality are wrong for simulating humans; simulations must model biased, 'dumb' humans, not superintelligent ones.
joonpark.zh: 为理性优化的前沿模型不适合模拟人类；模拟必须建模有偏见的、'笨'的人类，而非超级智能。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, are the key data strategy; post-training on RCT data closes the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 行为数据与随机对照试验数据而非自陈态度才是关键数据战略；用随机对照试验数据做后训练能弥合'说与做'的差距。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning to shape the future, not prediction; a CERN-like societal simulator could tackle wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的价值在于用反事实推理塑造未来而非预测；类似 CERN 的社会模拟器可应对棘手问题。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion across agent economies.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是专业化智能体的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与跨智能体经济的反串谋。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 在 2026 年的 Y Combinator 访谈中，他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动（而非规划）才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; custom internal software beats bought ERP.
maxhodak.zh: 同场他指出 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，自建内部软件优于采购商用 ERP。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年 No Priors 访谈，他主张大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; the Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations.
maxhodak.zh: 他深化立场：视网膜假体属于 BCI，柏拉图表征假说把 AI 与大脑的内部表征联系起来。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 他进一步提出，借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is itself unsafe.
sutton.zh: AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身就不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a real goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测缺乏真正的目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种只从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习能力。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实世界经验。

iansilber.en: Designers must build directly with live models, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over static pixels.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他强调设计师必须直接与实时模型协作，把 token 和对话而非静态像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the product; design should expose capabilities the product currently hides, bridging the capability gap.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型本身就是产品，设计应把产品尚未暴露的能力释放出来，弥合能力差距。

iansilber.en: Designers should abandon the linear prototype-mock-test loop for rapid, messy prototyping with AI, prioritizing speed.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他主张放弃线性的原型—模拟—测试流程，转向与 AI 快速而混乱地原型迭代，速度优先。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, blurring with PM and engineering while specialists stay valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他认为设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人，与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专才仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Despite role uncertainty, this is the best time to be a designer; humans remain essential for user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持尽管角色充满不确定性，这仍是做设计师最好的时代，人类在理解用户与持有观点上不可替代。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——把原子当作比特——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The entrepreneur matters more than the idea; stealth mode and internal correctness beat external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创业者比点子更重要；隐身模式与内部正确性胜过外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Resistance to change, not competitors, is the final boss; hardcore resilience is the entrepreneur's core trait.
traviskalanick.zh: 变革阻力而非竞争对手才是最终 boss；硬核韧性是创业者的核心特质。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; efficiency edges create network effects and beat subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业规模下专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并战胜补贴。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, Scaling（规模扩张） of compute, data, and model size has driven steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把十多年来的持续进步归因于算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），并强调算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, while RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Transformer 以并行化和注意力机制取代 LSTM，并用下一个词预测做自监督学习获得无限数据，再以基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are the real bottleneck, not training.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体式系统已能自主执行长时任务，真正的瓶颈转向超低延迟推理与专用硬件，而非训练。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; data is not running out thanks to video, audio, robotics, synthetic data.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对预训练的看法：应让模型在环境中交错采取行动，而非只做被动的下一个词预测；视频、音频、机器人与合成数据意味着数据并未枯竭。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method are the next frontier; scarce skill becomes taste in choosing which problems to direct agents at.
jeffdean.zh: 最近他进一步提出，用机器学习改进机器学习的递归自我改进与自动化科学方法是下一前沿，稀缺能力将从写代码转向挑选值得让智能体攻克的问题的品味。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正带来泛化的是多样数据而非单纯规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning grows from a post-training aid into scalable RL with human interventions for long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从后训练中的辅助手段，深化为带人类干预的可扩展强化学习，以支撑长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune per site.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，应先通用再按场景微调，而非从零训练专用模型。

finn.en: Diverse data and physical-world experience remain the throughline; robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是多样数据与物理世界经验：机器人自身的经验数据不可替代，仅靠观看人类远远不够。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；诚实比精致更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延伸物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, guided by intuition as a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，由作为本能罗盘的直觉来引导。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 模型统治世界，认为专业化智能将占主导，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把重心从应用层转向后训练：把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，才是超越产品市场契合的真正护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 他提出从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶，对应人类从事实到品味再到专业能力的成长路径，这条主线贯穿其方法论。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 他预判三年内 token 成本降 10 倍、用量涨 100 倍，并强调先增长后利润，避免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中破产，这一成本与商业张力贯穿始终。

linqiao.en: Open and sovereign models plus specialized inference deployment create lasting value; frontier model firms may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 他持续看多开放与主权模型及专业化推理部署的长期价值，并质疑前沿模型公司估值过高，认为推理层并非商品化。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while redefining its AI strategy around purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调英特尔要靠谦逊、倾听客户和一次流片成功纪律重建客户信任，并围绕专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把英特尔转型的核心放在文化变革、问责和客户导向上，并强调坏消息要比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要，不再只是 GPU 的配角。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, new materials—and Intel's vertical integration creates more value despite outsourcing trends.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张半导体投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热、新材料等瓶颈，并认为英特尔的垂直整合在行业外包趋势下反而创造更多价值。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view of the codebase; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体对代码库的视角，短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox before exposing agents publicly.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，公开暴露智能体前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能难以为继。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven play drive the best agentic work; the real bottleneck is compute and tokens, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动的玩耍催生最好的智能体工作；真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型能力。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and less capital-intensive; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar companies, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、更少依赖资本；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large firms, making traditional hiring obsolete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮；小而自主的团队借助智能体可超越大公司，传统招聘模式因此过时。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence; AI should be personal and open.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重模型是对抗前沿实验室、防止超级智能单极化的关键；AI 应走向个人化与开放。

garrytan.en: AGI won't arrive as one event but diffuse as personal agents; owning your context library and skill files is the real moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会以单一事件降临，而是以个人智能体扩散；拥有自己的上下文库与技能文件才是真正护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents are a workforce, not autocomplete; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, though society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张 Markdown 即代码、智能体是劳动力而非自动补全；中层管理应被智能体取代，但社会变迁仍需约 20 年。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization and safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化与安全的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场深化：开源与安全正交，随着模型能力增强，对齐而非开放才是关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring harder.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客，推理轨迹变成“神经语”，使监控更难。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown in AI is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张有意的 AI 减速是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是黏性最强的 AI 工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make the boundary blurry.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让两者边界变得模糊。

philipkiely.en: Optimization splits into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization), each needing workload-specific calibration.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）两类，各自都需要针对具体工作负载做校准。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs; inference work shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration and KV cache management.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化；推理工作从写内核转向基础设施编排与 KV 缓存管理。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference systems: can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理系统仍需人类担责：不能靠感觉写可用性。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and keep individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张浏览器设计必须靠原型验证：设计师应追随好奇心、动手试错，并保留个人印记，而非始终作为一个整齐划一的团队行动。

nateparrott.en: Consistently balances intuition and data, but increasingly trusts vision and feeling over metrics as AI makes execution cheap.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终在直觉与数据之间求平衡，但随着 AI 让执行变廉价，他越来越信任愿景与感觉，而非指标。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; rich context and prescriptive prompts matter more than polished mockups.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他讲述 Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目：丰富的上下文与明确的指令比精致的 mockup 更重要。
