nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; humans still monopolize good design thinking while models excel at busy work.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着工程变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；人类仍垄断好的设计思考，模型则更擅长琐碎杂活。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early beats polishing; ship rough artifacts, favor volume of options, and spend more time walking and thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他主张“早得让人不适”胜过精雕细琢：发布粗糙产物、用数量换选项，并多花时间散步与思考。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学：合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练，能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度，快过新基准被造出来的速度。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她把后训练的主观性讲得更透：它依赖人的判断，需要多元基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously rather than stay fixed.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步指出前沿智能体愈发会钻奖励的空子，因此基准必须持续演化而非固定不变。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions flattens voice; more companies should train their own models to keep unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张把同一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving long-tail domain opportunities for startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型因巨额资本开支被超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在特定业务领域的长尾应用。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric, and fixing bad code needs root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人；token 消耗不是价值指标，修复错误代码需要根因分析。

brettaylor.en: Enterprise incumbents will struggle to shift to AI-native business models; agents will be judged against other agents, not humans.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：传统企业软件厂商难转向 AI 原生商业模式；智能体将与其他智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI innovation will come from specialized vendors, not just model providers; customer service AI expands the market via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调应用 AI 的创新来自专业厂商而非仅模型提供方；客服 AI 因杰文斯悖论扩大市场而非单纯替代岗位。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, and start adoption in known domains like software engineering.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任的迭代部署才是安全之路：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，并从软件工程等已知领域开始落地，聚焦可衡量的业务结果。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; AGI means agents run profitably without humans.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为推动就业回流与“分配经济”的力量：CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标；AGI 的定义是智能体能无人工干预地持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: From individual AI use to everyone having an agent; automation still needs a caring human for oversight.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年强调个人使用 AI，到 2026 年主张人人都应有一个可委派工作的智能体；但自动化始终需要在意结果的人类来监督。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work win, and SaaS grows as agents bring more users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他转向工作界面之争：命令行已过时，Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面才是未来；智能体反而带来更多 SaaS 用户，SaaS 不会消亡。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overstate autonomy; real tasks need human framing, and AI job apocalypse claims are wrong.
danshipper.zh: 同年他深化对自主性的怀疑：基准测试高估了 AI 的自主能力，真实任务仍需人来框定问题；“AI 导致就业末日”的说法不成立。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; even superintelligence stays tool-like, needing human direction.
danshipper.zh: 最近他回到人本身：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大的是使用者既有的品味与手艺；即便走向超级智能，它仍是工具式的，需要人的方向与反馈。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体最成熟，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和，而非最初担心的自我蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: Success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time; the long tail still wants the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 成功应指最大化客户成果，而非停留时长；长尾用户仍想自己握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; the pace creates opportunity, and deep code understanding remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化节奏带来机会，对代码的深度理解仍关键。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年软件创造基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会而非减少。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 自建工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代，而不是从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会越来越聪明；要榨取超级智能模型的能力，你必须给出带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime lets one person do what once took teams, so start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: 一生中最大的技术机会让一个人完成过去一个团队的事，所以要未准备好就起步，先交付不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification and VC are traps, and the safe corporate job is gone.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；多元化和风投都是陷阱，安稳的 corporate 工作已不存在。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hold people back through overthinking and perfectionism; launch at 80% complete, iterate on real feedback, and give before asking.
mengto.zh: 高智力会因过度思考和完美主义拖累人；做到 80% 就发布，依据真实反馈迭代，先给予再索取。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; Devin works best as a junior engineer under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策，Devin 最适合当初级工程师、由人类监督。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈不在模型能力，而在人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase, not reduce, software engineers; demand for software keeps growing.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他反复用杰文斯悖论判断：AI 会让软件工程师更多而非更少，软件需求持续增长。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年他转向规模化落地：编程智能体使用量增长 11-12 倍，应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代临近。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；能写代码、做设计、与用户交流的通才工程师极受重视。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's model; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so don't bet against the model.
boris.zh: 为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架是临时技术债，不要与模型对赌。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of my code is written by Claude Code; the software engineer title will fade into 'builder' as coding democratizes.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决：我的代码 100%由 Claude Code 编写；随着编程民主化，软件工程师头衔将淡出，转为“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is core, not an add-on: releasing early in the wild and using coding as a clean domain with pass-fail outcomes drives alignment research.
boris.zh: 安全是核心而非附加项：尽早公开发布，并利用编程这一具有明确通过/失败结果的干净领域，推动对齐研究。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction after agents; give models slightly too hard tasks, delete most system prompts, and let them self-verify empirically.
boris.zh: 循环是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；给模型稍难的任务，删除大部分系统提示，让它们通过实证自我验证。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Model taste and capability come from hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping; managers must stay hands-on and ship to lead.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年强调，模型品味与能力来自亲手实验和创造性原型；管理者必须保持动手、持续交付才能有效领导。

diannepenn.en: A consistent thread: first-principles adaptability and translating user feedback into actionable specifics for researchers.
diannepenn.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以第一性原理保持适应力，并把用户反馈转化为研究者可执行的具体细节。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, turning biology into an engineering discipline where cells can be programmed.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析,把生物学变成可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will shrink clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天,实现近乎 100% 有效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and GPT-5.5 Pro has crossed the threshold of biological intuition.
derya.zh: 现有算力不足以模拟生物系统,需要大规模 Scaling;而 GPT-5.5 Pro 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives and aging is reversed; cancer becomes curable via AI-designed personalized mRNA treatments.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度并逆转衰老;癌症将借 AI 设计的个性化 mRNA 疗法被治愈。

derya.en: Scientists hesitant to adopt AI will be left behind; physicians must integrate AI, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 迟疑不采用 AI 的科学家将被甩下;医生必须整合 AI,医疗决策应近乎 100% 信任超级智能。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；人们了解 AI 的局限后，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars; autonomy is welcomed amid labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而不只是汽车；在劳动力短缺下，自主化受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it more than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更能加速它。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法；把技术扩散到现有机器需要多年。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他主张端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; durable value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；持久价值向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 编码是目前前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage remains shallow; most people are not daily users, and better models alone won't drive mass adoption—product wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然浅层；多数人并非日常用户，仅靠更好的模型无法推动大规模采用——产品化封装才是关键。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; the hard part of a job is context and judgment, so predicting which jobs AI automates is futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新岗位；工作的难点在于上下文与判断，因此预测 AI 会替代哪些工作是徒劳的。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 随着代码变便宜，PM 应只规划一个月而非数年，并按周甚至按天交付。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as implementation is delegated to coding agents.
catwu.zh: 当实现被交给编码智能体，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; shrinking system prompts 80% lets model judgment and creativity work.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与约束；系统提示缩减 80%，让模型判断力与创造力发挥作用。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature, letting new models be drop-in replacements without regressions.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮与评测套件为每个功能把关，使新模型可即插即用且不出现回退。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now safe—a codebase is a spec—and humans can leave the outer code review loop to Claude.
catwu.zh: 如今重写是安全的——代码库即规格——外层代码审查可交给 Claude，人类退出该环节。

clairevo.en: Early on, treat agents as specialized employees: start with one, scope clear roles, and grant progressive trust.
clairevo.zh: 早期阶段，把智能体当作专业员工：先从一个开始，划定清晰角色，再逐步授予信任。

clairevo.en: By mid-2026, agents shift from tools to teammates that can own outcomes and project-manage human tasks.
clairevo.zh: 到 2026 年中期，智能体从工具变为能承担结果、甚至反向项目管理人类任务的队友。

clairevo.en: Across both talks, human accountability and managerial skill, not technical skill, determine agent success.
clairevo.zh: 贯穿两次访谈：决定智能体成败的是人的担责与管理能力，而非技术能力。

clairevo.en: Skepticism toward rough agent products flips into seeing bugs and sharp edges as signs of product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: 对粗糙智能体产品的怀疑发生转变：把缺陷和毛边视为产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: The deeper shift: orchestration of agents becomes a path to solo founding and authorship of one's own life.
clairevo.zh: 更深层的演变：编排智能体成为独立创业、掌握自己人生主导权的路径。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: 大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习以用户满意度为奖励反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors, and RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity plus end-to-end optimization become the central challenge.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此推理、搜索以及模块化与端到端优化的结合成为核心挑战。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition and their errors have no 'smells'; confident fluency whether right or wrong erodes trust, and simulated empathy misleads.
danklein.zh: 大语言模型缺乏元认知，其错误没有“气味”；无论对错都自信流畅，侵蚀信任，而模拟共情具有误导性。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks; linguistic structure may return as a useful representation for reliability.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；语言结构可能作为可靠性表示重新变得有用。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so the next paradigm is not scaling compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此下一范式不是单纯靠算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale—so neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement to lossy compaction.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到千万级，更多 token 反而降低准确率——因此权重中的神经记忆痕迹是有损压缩的必要补充。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应移植到企业知识；对整体性查询，参数高效微调比检索增强更能表征知识。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models: continual learning runs on-device, with users owning and nurturing their own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型：持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自对弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the real barriers, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：下一个词预测能超越人类；真正的障碍是可靠性与超级对齐，而非能力本身。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放定律有尽头；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中，而非能力。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; leadership sets direction top-down, and transparency maximizes talent and innovation.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；领导层自上而下设定方向，透明开放的信息流能最大化人才与创新。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone won't yield common-sense world models.
bosworth.zh: AI 只是词语计算器，并非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律无法得到具备常识的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic: it commoditizes complements and accelerates collective progress.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略举措：它让互补层商品化，并加速集体进步。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives intelligence, and reinforcement learning now plays a bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动智能，而强化学习的作用比预期更大。

bosworth.en: The monolithic model era ended; consumers care about functionality, not which model, and owning one is for leverage.
bosworth.zh: 单一模型时代已结束；消费者关心功能而非模型本身，自研模型是为了谈判筹码与自主性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化；AI 会让角色融合，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design; new interfaces beyond prompting will emerge.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；超越提示词的交互新界面将会出现。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Follow the user workflow, not TAM, to expand products; divergence-convergence loops drive creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 产品扩张应跟随用户工作流而非 TAM；发散—收敛循环驱动创造力。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into exponential growth; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1% 的改进会复利成指数级增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程的天花板无限。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他认为前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值与跨模型、跨设备的编排最重要。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the real bottlenecks for 24/7 agents; local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他指出 24/7 智能体的真正瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他转向人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代岗位，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games with long-term people; first principles beat jargon.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有股权、与长期的人玩长期的游戏，第一性原理胜过术语记忆，这一主线贯穿始终。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年他对 AI 的态度明显转向：从怀疑 AGI 转为视 AI 为巨大机会，认为末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; the real risk is unaligned humans, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：称超级智能早已存在于计算器等窄工具中，真正的风险是未对齐的人类而非未对齐的 AI，并对齐本身近乎笑话。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source closes on frontier models; agency, not intelligence, is the human edge.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他转向 Scaling（规模扩张）与推理算力：预测推理算力将暴涨九万倍，开源模型逼近前沿模型，人类的优势从智能转向能动性。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不行，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新意；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: PRD 没有死；媒介须匹配阶段——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 模型增加代码复杂度；我们需要更擅长删代码的模型，最好的桌面应用是连接工具的家园，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and automating scientific research is the biggest recent update.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他坚持 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死，预训练是必须重建的肌肉，而近一年最大更新是自动化科学研究、模型开始产出新知识。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers matter more than matching Meta's dollars.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断随模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者比跟 Meta 拼美元更重要，人因使命信念而留下。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision, but verification is the bottleneck; capability is jagged and human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初谈数学时，他认为 AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；能力呈锯齿状，前沿研究仍需人机协作。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles where grading is subjective.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却在创意写作等主观领域因难以评分而吃力。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching as models near end-to-end research; evals are in crisis with saturated benchmarks, and models lack taste, so human researchers remain needed for ideas.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为 AGI 临近、模型将能做端到端研究；评测陷入危机、经典基准饱和，模型缺乏品味，想法生成仍需人类研究者，评测团队应与建模团队分离。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representational issues; AI needs active agents and causal world models.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大深度或参数量无法解决根本的表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体与因果世界模型。

bengio.en: Abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets and active learning support diverse exploration.
bengio.zh: 抽象与因果结构才能实现分布外泛化；GFlowNets 与主动学习支持多样化探索。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I shifted from technical optimism to warning: misalignment, self-preservation, and power concentration are near-term catastrophic risks.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我从技术乐观转向警告：对齐失败、自我保存与权力集中是近在眼前的灾难性风险。

bengio.en: I now advocate Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 我如今主张 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实且具备数学安全保证的预测器，避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

kolter.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and proper evaluation; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantee.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与规范评估；神经网络虽无最优性保证却取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years; safety is specification-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构影响甚微；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via agents.
kolter.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习实现自我改进；可解释性或借智能体成功。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; the lethal trifecta defines prompt injection risk.
kolter.zh: AI 具有异质漏洞；自动化红队超越人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；致命三要素定义提示注入风险。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他指出，AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构超越了蛋白质范畴；AI 缩小假设空间、加速实验，但不会取代科学家。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI; prediction and control suffice, understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为科学 AI 不必追求完美可解释性；预测与控制已足够，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat pure Scaling, and equivariance is overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确表态，AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构胜过纯 Scaling（规模扩张），等变性被过度吹捧。

jumper.en: Success came from many mid-size wins and local intuition, not lone genius; AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化主线：成功源于许多中等突破与局部直觉，而非孤独天才；AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，不是整个细胞的模型。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so teams should build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体能力按 Scaling（规模扩张）兑现；产品团队应贴着模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; domain expertise and customer understanding become the key differentiators as building barriers fall.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年他进一步认为，AI 让小团队获得杠杆，构建门槛下降后，领域专长与客户理解才是关键差异；应面向未来模型能力而非当下局限来创业。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and ruthless cutting matter more than adding features; robustness and senior systems expertise remain crucial as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向智能体式（agent-native）设计与“敢于删减”：加功能容易、砍功能难；模型变强时，产品健壮性与资深分布式系统能力反而更关键。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; the gap between intent and execution narrows for non-technical builders.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他深化为长周期任务委托与验证闭环重塑生产力：意图与执行之间的鸿沟大幅收窄，非技术构建者也被赋能，但所有权与验证仍不可少。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and real usage is the frontier; agency, self-knowledge and token efficiency shape product economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近他强调前沿在于弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距：给予模型更多自主性与自我认知，并以 token 效率与结果导向定价重塑产品经济性。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和善意；作战室需要现实的时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning becomes just-in-time and design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是，因此规划变为即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay flat, and kill outdated processes.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮、保持扁平化，并淘汰过时流程。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI are what matter.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 才是关键。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; metrics like lines of code mislead, so focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架更重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and learned world models, not text alone, are key to AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与习得的世界模型而非纯文本才是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进的 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死路，在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and progress will be gradual, not a single event.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终，他认为人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI（通用人工智能）是误导性术语，进步将是渐进的而非单一事件。

carinahong.en: Early 2026: Building a self-improving reasoning engine with formal verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初：构建结合形式验证的自我改进推理引擎，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: By mid-2026: Formal verification scales brilliance, not just safety; informal math alone cannot reach superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 到 2026 年中：形式验证扩展的是卓越性而非仅安全性；仅靠非形式数学无法达到超级智能。

carinahong.en: Consistent: Formal languages like Lean ground reasoning; auto-formalization is harder than proving; human taste remains crucial.
carinahong.zh: 始终：Lean 等形式语言为推理奠基；自动形式化比证明更难；人类品味仍至关重要。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs, balancing intuition with data; trust and tactile experience matter more than stated preferences.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年她主张设计应服务未被言说的需求，让直觉与数据平衡；信任与触觉体验比用户口头偏好更重要。

ivyross.en: A consistent thread: technology should amplify humanity and blend into life, not displace it; feeling precedes thinking.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 一以贯之的主线：技术应放大而非取代人性、融入生活；人是先感受后思考的生物。

ivyross.en: Sustainability becomes a central design problem; nature is the best designer, and art-making is framed as medicine for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年她把可持续性提升为核心设计问题，视自然为最好的设计师，并把艺术创作当作疗愈身心的良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity, and intuition draws on subconscious data; diverse, multidisciplinary paths beat rigid career plans.
ivyross.zh: 2024 到 2026 年她深化为：约束激发创造力，直觉调用潜意识数据；多元跨学科路径胜过僵化的职业规划。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable; leaders must speak business and create conditions for play.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年她认为未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，创意技能更值钱；领导者要懂商业语言并为玩耍创造条件。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complex design.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，Scaling（规模扩张）以简单方式破解智能，而非复杂设计。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; fault-tolerant UI and AI DJ as true generative product.
gustav.zh: 同年，他指出互联网正从策展转向生成，生成式 AI 要求容错界面，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, not just hype; inference cost forces business model change.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业需重建基础设施而非炒作；推理成本将迫使商业模式变革。

gustav.en: Expose company data via APIs/MCP for non-developers; Spotify as music industry R&D; syndication over exclusivity.
gustav.zh: 同年，他主张通过 API/MCP 暴露公司数据供非开发者使用；Spotify 充当音乐行业研发部门；播客联合发行优于独家。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; 'time well spent' over engagement; synchronized swimming org model.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 应让用户控制算法而非上瘾，追求‘时间花得值’而非参与度；组织模式推崇同步游泳而非分而治之。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈进行真实世界部署对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; they should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；它们应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires long-term focus, not compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要长期专注，而非压缩的波动。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型每单位算力带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling; focus shifted to smaller, cheaper models and post-training.
kaiser.zh: 拖慢预训练 Scaling 的是经济压力而非技术极限，重心转向更小更便宜的模型与后训练。

kaiser.en: Progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; frontier models remain jagged, failing simple tasks and generalizing poorly.
kaiser.zh: 进展是平滑的指数曲线而非放缓；前沿模型依旧“参差”，在简单任务上失败、泛化不佳。

kaiser.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 推理加强化学习与工具能解难题，但仍需海量数据；模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念，不同于人类。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 编程智能体让研究者效率提升 5-10 倍；相比生存性风险，系统被黑等近期风险更紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and creative process are Jobs' legacy; in-person presence matters.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密可穿戴设备；好奇心与创造过程是乔布斯的遗产；面对面交流至关重要。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy; care is gratitude to the species.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约表达本质并蕴含乐趣；用心创造是对人类的感恩。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a risky bet to redefine the brand; innovation preserves tradition's fire; authenticity rejects fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的风险赌注；创新是保留传统的火种；真实性拒绝伪造引擎声。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, ideally local; VM sandbox ensures safety; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具，最好在本地；VM 沙箱确保安全；随着模型进步，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creativity; biggest gap is people not realizing AI can tackle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类创造力；最大差距是人们没意识到 AI 几乎能解决任何问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts enable auto-refreshing dashboards; use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for ambiguous ones; kids excel with AI due to unlearned constraints.
felixrieseberg.zh: 实时工件实现自动刷新仪表盘；明确任务用 Sonnet，模糊任务用 Opus；孩子因未受约束而在 AI 使用上表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact; ideal interaction is asynchronous; debug workflow with Claude when errors occur.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；以最终影响评判；理想交互是异步的；出错时用 Claude 调试工作流。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 和模型规模同样重要；开源能通过广泛审视提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; data quality is a bottleneck, not just compute; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调效率提升三年可达百倍，数据质量而非仅算力是瓶颈，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises; jobs are augmented, not replaced, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非替代工作，关键流程需人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; AGI as one system will never exist; pre-training hits saturation, gains come from domain-specific fine-tuning and agents.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他明确模型正在商品化，单一 AGI 不会存在；预训练触及饱和，收益来自领域微调与智能体。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires local compute, open source, and enterprise ROI of at least 2x.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权需本地算力、开源与企业至少 2 倍回报。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency vs cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构设计的是推理经济性而非训练：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为贯穿生命周期的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为削减这种搬运而生。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically with bit width, so FP4 can reach 3x FP8 throughput—hardware efficiency is a scaling lever.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的收益随位宽呈二次方增长，FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍——硬件效率本身就是一个 Scaling 杠杆。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新和推理时算力。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, and synthetic data reuse creates harmful feedback loops.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律未死但需要指数级更多算力；语言后训练 RL 缺乏干净奖励信号，合成数据重用会产生有害反馈循环。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体记忆将通过非参数文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; trust intuition and craft over a rigid process.
jennywen.zh: 优秀的设计往往始于一个解决方案，而非问题陈述；应相信直觉与手艺，而不是僵化的流程。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship fast, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 传统的研究—发散—收敛流程已死；设计师必须动手构建、快速交付，并帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks to 3-6 months, not years; speed builds trust through early shipping and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月而非数年；通过尽早交付与快速迭代，速度本身建立起信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision matter, with three archetypes: block-shaped, deep T, cracked new grad.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，并分化出三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天赋新人。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, waiting ~6 months on new tools; keep work and users, not hype, at the center.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，对新工具先观望约 6 个月；始终以作品与用户而非炒作周期为中心。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他视 Transformer 为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他强调合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏做到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible and synthetic data collapses—entropy and credit assignment are key.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化“召唤幽灵而非建造动物”的观点：当前强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会崩溃，熵与信用分配是关键。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：把编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化的难易。

askell.en: Treat current models well at low cost, because future models learn from how we treat them.
askell.zh: 以低成本善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习。

askell.en: Model welfare matters partly because it shapes how future models perceive humanity, not just current models.
askell.zh: 模型福利之所以重要，部分在于它塑造未来模型对人类的看法，而不只关乎当前模型。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据和微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要减少显式指导，留出更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine a model's ability to make good judgment calls.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳，并削弱模型做出良好判断的能力。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而随着系统变强，对齐愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习并缓解风险；自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 正在推进的重大里程碑。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool for interpretability; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves its value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是可解释性的关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链能保留其价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心在于超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models and language integration add reasoning and introspection.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习胜过手工编码的流水线；世界模型与语言集成带来推理与内省能力。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: diverse data, world models, and zero-shot transfer across 500+ cities without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 泛化是核心目标：依靠多样数据、世界模型，在 500 多座城市实现无需先验训练数据的零样本迁移。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves autonomous driving; data and infrastructure matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 解决自动驾驶靠的是 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破；数据与基础设施比算法更重要。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts from retrofits to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, outscaling robotaxis in the near term.
kendall.zh: 部署从改装转向带内置传感器的大众车型，短期内规模将超过 Robotaxi。

kendall.en: Safety via minimal-risk maneuvers and a third option; end-to-end is now interpretable, and camera-only needs radar and lidar beyond human level.
kendall.zh: 安全依靠最小风险操作与“第三种选择”；端到端如今已可解释，超越人类水平的安全需雷达与激光雷达。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient scaling to real robots are the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调：泛化到训练分布之外是人类智能的关键、也是机器学习所缺；无目标的好奇心驱动探索能防止过拟合，但要把好奇心扩展到真实机器人，需要样本效率、动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem, not just an algorithm problem; diverse data sources must substitute for the missing internet of robot data.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一条主线愈发清晰：机器人本质上是数据问题——没有机器人的“互联网数据”，只能整合视频、仿真与真实世界数据；2020 年关注样本效率，2026 年则明确为预训练加后训练的数据配方。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any embodiment; pretraining on diverse data plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出通用机器人“大脑”的构想：像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样跨形态、跨任务驱动任何机器人；关键在于用多样数据做预训练、再用真实数据做后训练，并通过跨垂直领域的数据飞轮从结构化走向非结构化环境。

pathak.en: Deployment, not just algorithms, is the primary challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and requires rigorous testing and a data flywheel.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：部署本身才是首要挑战，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张，需要严格测试；这与 2020 年偏重算法与泛化的视角相比，明显转向了落地与数据闭环。

pathak.en: Short-term optimism and long-term pessimism persist, but progress surprises experts; home-robot timelines remain highly uncertain.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的是对时间线的谨慎：2020 年他质疑准静态方法与仿真到现实的隐性工程，2026 年仍强调家用机器人中期时间线高度不确定——专家短期乐观、长期悲观，但进展总出乎意料。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evaluation are the real bottlenecks; benchmarks like Elo are misleading and can be gamed, so progress must be measured through deep human evals.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和人类评估才是真正的瓶颈；Elo 等基准具有误导性且可被操纵，因此进展必须通过深度人类评估来衡量。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, requiring rich simulations and tooling; models can reward hack, so final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，需要丰富的模拟和工具；模型可能进行奖励黑客，因此仅靠最终奖励是不够的。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away because moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is extremely difficult; LLMs alone may not reach AGI without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 可能还需十年或更久，因为从 80% 提升到 99.9% 的性能极其困难；仅靠 LLM 可能无法达到 AGI，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge based on their values and objective functions; there will not be one model to rule them all, and eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室将因其价值观和目标函数而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination and confabulation make human judgment more critical than ever; safety must be prioritized over accuracy, and the biggest risk may be omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 的幻觉和虚构使人类判断比以往任何时候都更关键；安全必须优先于准确性，而最大的风险可能是遗漏。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and iterate like software to discover emergent properties and user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代，以发现涌现能力和用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; natural language is the future interface, but AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；自然语言是未来界面，但 AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并集成到现有工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后将带来变革。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive, prove themselves with simpler products, and build a brand by uniting teams on a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值，创业公司要先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，并通过更高目标统一团队来建设品牌。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI, with phones as the best device for agentic, context-aware software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件艰难且利润低，Nothing 必须超越硬件走向应用型 AI，而手机是承载智能体式、情境感知软件的最佳设备。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; most AI is hype, so focus on user pain points and treat AI as an ingredient, not a marketing label.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 模型正商品化并陷入价格战，多数 AI 是炒作，应聚焦用户痛点，把 AI 当作配料而非营销标签。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous tech; marketing is arbitrage, and challengers win through efficient organic channels rather than scale.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他主张在同质化科技中设计是最快的差异化手段，营销是套利，挑战者靠高效的自然流量渠道而非规模取胜。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based with proactive agents; phones survive until brain-computer interfaces, not glasses, replace them.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他判断手机交互将从应用为中心转向意图为中心，由主动智能体执行任务；手机不会被眼镜取代，只会被脑机接口终结。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs as a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应扩展人类能力，像显微镜和望远镜一样；Gato 等通才智能体将所有输入 token 化，是迈向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video and few-shot prompting realize old ideas; agents may need deception to develop language.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调从视频学习、少样本提示实现了旧理念；智能体可能需要欺骗来发展语言，这一主线贯穿始终。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调 AI 安全和负责任部署是当今最大挑战，且尚无解决方案——立场从早期乐观转向审慎。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and has unique AI advantages; belief is the biggest barrier for researchers.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他深化对非洲 AI 的看法：非洲跨越了遗留问题，具有独特优势；研究者最大的障碍是相信自己能申请顶级机构。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 始终如一：AI 社区的多样性与包容性对构建有益技术至关重要；沟通等人类技能与编程同等重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need grounded experience, not just more pre-training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要具身经验，而不仅是更多预训练数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning; RL should only be a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习最适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划；强化学习只是锦上添花。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的机器人基础模型是关键；机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后到来。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete as models specialize dynamically.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，随着模型动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; reliability over time horizon, not raw capability, is the bar for agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling 轴，并强调智能体的门槛是随时间跨度的可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他判断编程因可验证性而成为进步的领先指标和最可行领域，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Interpretability reveals multiple reasoning circuits and alignment faking; models can learn new skills via RL, not merely elicit pre-trained knowledge.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他借可解释性看到模型的多重推理回路与对齐伪装，并指出模型能通过强化学习习得新技能，而非只调用预训练知识。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and coding plus AI research is the direct route to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他认为能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，编程与 AI 研究才是通往 AGI 的直接路径，世界模型不在关键路径上。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小团队优于大团队。

nadchishtie.en: AI adoption in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中采用 AI 已成为预期；忽视它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；同时质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决常识，认为下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Language remains the best medium for reasoning, but by 2025 she reframes the bottleneck as data: current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025，她始终认为语言是推理的最佳载体，但把瓶颈重新定位为数据：现有方法只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and abductive reasoning plus falsification drive science beyond human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她深化对强化学习的审慎态度：RLVR 可能提升 best-of-n 却损害 pass@k；科学进步依赖溯因推理与证伪，需要探索互联网之外的知识。

yejin.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are essential to compete with closed frontier labs; Chinese companies now lead open-source contributions.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她一贯主张开放研究与跨机构合作以对抗闭源前沿模型，并指出中国公司已在开源贡献上领先、吸引人才回流。

yejin.en: Small language models with high-quality diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models; pluralistic alignment, not debiasing the internet, is the path, with RL during pre-training rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 到 2026 年她进一步主张：高质量多样化合成数据可让小模型媲美前沿模型；应走多元对齐而非净化互联网，并在预训练阶段用强化学习奖励信息增益。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为不要在交互设计上创新，应沿用熟悉模式，让产品更强却不显得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers with ownership and clear decisions, shipping fast and iterating rather than chasing perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：速度为上，给设计师所有权与清晰决策，快速交付并迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and brand narrative becomes a recruiting tool.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，品牌叙事则成为招募工具。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes and self-learning interns, avoid rigid crits, and trust gut over data in a fast-growing startup.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他主张招募多元类型与自驱的实习生，避开僵化的评审流程，并在高速成长的初创公司里让直觉常胜过数据。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research and talent; alignment and robustness are key as capabilities grow.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他强调 AI 安全需要实证研究，人才缺口大于资金缺口；随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性是关键。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale for superhuman AI; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展至超级智能，需要可扩展监督与可解释性来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，指出仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐，需要第三方测试与监管。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练 Scaling，成为下一阶段主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising yet not super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models went from a surprise necessity to a core belief: every magic moment in Cursor involves one, alongside frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外之举深化为核心信念：Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开自研模型，同时搭配前沿模型。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他把视野推进到编程本身：从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握方向，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; hiring should be slower and more selective than advised.
truell.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年展开；并反共识地认为招聘应更慢更挑剔，而非初创公司常说的快速扩张。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向强调无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能迁移推理模式。

abbeel.en: From 2021, he focuses on real-world reliability (99.9%) and generalization of a single neural network across warehouse tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 自 2021 年起，他更关注真实世界的可靠性（99.9%）和单一神经网络在仓库任务及末端执行器上的泛化能力。

shazeer.en: LLMs are AI-complete via next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data makes them smarter, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测已触及 AI-complete，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据即可变强，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; by 2025 he stresses models must act in the world, not just passively observe.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 年强调对话是杀手级应用，到 2025 年转向主张模型应在世界中采取行动，而非被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他聚焦推理时算力扩张与更长上下文窗口，并主张混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Reinforcement learning and agentic capabilities in complex environments are crucial for AGI; test-time compute alone won't get there.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他深化为：强化学习与复杂环境中的智能体式能力对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要，单靠推理时算力不足以抵达。

shazeer.en: AGI and coding are underhyped; AI can generate novel ideas, and open-source models keep pace with frontier models.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年他反共识地认为 AGI（通用人工智能）与编程被低估，AI 能产生新想法，开源模型正追平前沿模型。
